forbidden: multiple simultaneous authoritative scopes on one object

selection.A_wins: B/C show no necessary correctness benefit and add state/constraint complexity
selection.B_wins: only if executable evidence shows a necessary runtime query/reconstruction capability unreachable by A/C, without relaxing L1-L12
selection.C_wins: only if minimal runtime relations show proven B-utility at lower complexity while staying non-authoritative
selection.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE on unstable winner, unsupported round-trip or close tradeoff

sensitivity.rule: any winner flip is recorded and caps the verdict at INCONCLUSIVE

status_cap: PASS_WITH_LIMITS at most; production implementation conformance unproven
